description: Ministry of Defence - Order under section 2(1) of National Hydrographic Act, No .7 of 2024
reasoning: This gazette content announces the commencement date of the National Hydrography Act, No. 7 of 2024. It is a legal notice published under the authority of the Minister of Defence, specifying when the provisions of the Act come into operation. This falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5), which include "New laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "Legal notices and statutory declarations." Although a named individual (Ranil Wickremesinghe) is present, the primary purpose is to enact a law, not to detail government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
